title: Inspect a data entity in application context
statement: As an Architect or Developer, I can easily find the specific details of a data entity in the ERD so I understand its structure, purpose, and role in the wider application.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The ERD root has an expandable directory of its data entities; selecting an entity in either the diagram or directory opens the same canonical entity definition.
Entity details expose its described structure, purpose, and storage-resource context, distinguishing the data entity from the queue, database, or other resource holding it.
Entity details identify related entities and explain their relationships, including logical flow from a queued payload to a persisted record, with navigation to those definitions.
Entity details expose exact code references with currency and links to the feature implementation decks, slides, and Items that use the entity.
